# strettchcloud_compute (Data Source)

Looks up a single compute instance by its id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up one compute by its id.
data "strettchcloud_compute" "web" {
  id = "325"
}

output "web_ip" {
  value = data.strettchcloud_compute.web.ipv4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Compute id to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `host_name` (String) Host name.
- `image` (String) Image slug.
- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `private_ipv4` (String) Private IPv4 address.
- `region` (String) Region slug.
- `specification` (String) Specification slug.
- `state` (String) Power state.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `with_public_ip` (Boolean) Whether the compute has a public IP.
